evidence.title: Arizona candidate for Congress says she was raped while fixing campaign sign

occurrences.checkable_against: Ruben Gallego's statement on X dated October 7, 2026
occurrences.quote_span: "We cannot tolerate political or sexual violence in any form. Those responsible must be held accountable."

occurrences.subject: Arizona politicians' responses to Bernadette Greene-Placentia alleged assault

occurrences.checkable_against: Abraham Hamadeh campaign statement on the alleged assault

occurrences.subject: Arizona politicians' responses to Bernadette Greene-Placentia alleged assault
